sources.core_claim: Quantpedia's 'Momentum Factor Effect in Country Equity Indexes' (source paper Muller & Ward 2010, Studies in Economics and Econometrics 34(1)): rank ~70 MSCI World country equity indexes by 10-12 month momentum, hold the top 4-5 for one month, monthly rebalance. Reported backtest 1970-2009 (Muller & Ward's own sample): the 4-best-of-70 portfolio outperformed an equal-weighted benchmark by ~10%/yr; Quantpedia's own figure-13 readout at Quantpedia's chosen parameters: 17.7%/yr, max drawdown -65.39%, Sharpe not disclosed. Quantpedia's page cites a 2024 update (Du & Jiang) noting the efficacy of ETF momentum strategies 'while robust until around 2010, began to show signs of waning in subsequent years.'
sources.project_applicability: Mechanism grounding only for all 8 COUNTRY_* candidates -- the rotation mechanism itself, not this paper's own 1970-2009 sample return/Sharpe numbers.
sources.reflection: Independently re-fetched via WebFetch this session (2026-09-29T05:20 UTC), full extraction saved to sources/quantpedia-country-momentum.md.

sources.core_claim: Muller & Ward (2010), 'Momentum Effects in Country Equity Indices,' Studies in Economics and Econometrics 34(1): a portfolio of the 4 best-performing MSCI country indexes over the trailing 11 months, held 1 month, persistently outperformed an equal-weighted benchmark by ~10%/yr over 1970-2009.
sources.project_applicability: The primary academic source underlying Quantpedia's own summary; grounds the cross-sectional-country-momentum mechanism, not this batch's own long-only, absolute-momentum-filtered, US-ETF, 2016-2026 implementation.
sources.reflection: Abstract/citation-level only (WebSearch this session); the original journal paper's full text was not independently opened -- Quantpedia's own page (fetched in full this session) already summarizes its key figures, so a second full-text read was judged low-value given the mechanism, not this paper's own numbers, is what this batch reuses.

sources.reflection: Read only as quoted within the Quantpedia page fetched this session; the original Du & Jiang paper itself was not independently located or opened.
